description: Read FAA certificate and rating codes, observed aircraft type designators, identity guidance, medical guidance, or local mirror status. Use these references to construct lookup filters and interpret snapshot limits. Static topics work before mirror initialization.

filter.description: Literal case-insensitive substring over code and description, 1–80 normalized characters; vocabulary topics only. Blank means unset.

limit.description: Maximum complete people or reference entries per page; default 10, maximum 50. A larger limit returns at most 50, with a notice.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; default 0, maximum 10000. Follow nextOffset or narrow filters at the cap.

topic.description: One FAA vocabulary, interpretation guide, or mirror diagnostic topic.

name: faa_airmen_list_reference

appliedFilters.description: Every effective normalized selector, filter, and paging value.

atPagingCap.description: Matches remain but the next offset exceeds 10000; narrow the filters.

entries.description: Complete matching reference entries for this page.

certificateType.description: Certificate type qualifying a level code.

code.description: Verbatim source code; unknown values remain usable.

description.description: FAA documented meaning, absent for unknown codes.

obsolete.description: Whether the documented rating is obsolete.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: Invalid reference topic, filter text, or filter/topic combination after normalization. `mirror_missing`: No complete published mirror generation is available. `mirror_unavailable`: Published generation is corrupt, missing, incompatible, or unreadable. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: Whether another page is reachable within the offset cap.

mirrorStatus.description: Safe diagnostic state present only for mirror_status.

lastRefreshFailure.description: Classified stage of the last refresh that did not complete, such as acquisition, schema, validation, disk, lock, or integrity; cancelled when its caller stopped it, timeout when one of its own deadlines expired, interrupted when its process ended without recording a result. Never paths or raw exception text.

provenance.description: Latest successful generation provenance, when available.

ageBasis.description: Publication timestamp or conservative first-of-month age basis.

ageDays.description: Source age in days, independent of import time.

complete.description: Only complete published snapshots are readable.

fileCounts.description: Source member filenames mapped to imported row counts.

includeLocation.description: Generation import policy: city and ZIP kept at import, not what this response returns.

publishedAt.description: FAA publication timestamp, only when explicitly supplied.

snapshotMonth.description: Advertised publication month in YYYY-MM format, not an exact effective date.

stale.description: Source exceeds the configured age threshold; not a credential judgment.

staleAfterDays.description: Configured source-age warning threshold in days.

malformedDates.description: Count of retained malformed source dates.

malformedRatings.description: Count of retained malformed source ratings.

unknownCodes.description: Count of retained unknown source codes.

refreshState.description: Most recent refresh lifecycle state: idle when none is recorded or the last one completed, running while one is in progress within its 40-minute deadline, failed when the last one did not complete (see lastRefreshFailure), unreadable when its record cannot be read or is not a valid refresh record, which leaves state and lookups unaffected; the entry guidance names the repair.

nextOffset.description: Next reachable offset, or null when no next page is available.

notice.description: Snapshot limitations, absence guidance, source-quality notices for the returned records, paging notices (a clamped limit, the offset cap, or a page the response size budget ended before limit), and operational notices; may be empty.

piiRedacted.description: Operator personal-data redaction: true withholds city, ZIP, and medical fields and limits searches to a full name or Unique ID.

anyOf.description: Per-call source provenance; topic mirror_status returns the full record.

ageBasis.description: Publication timestamp or conservative first-of-month age basis.

ageDays.description: Source age in days, independent of import time.

includeLocation.description: Generation import policy: city and ZIP kept at import, not what this response returns.

snapshotMonth.description: Advertised publication month in YYYY-MM format, not an exact effective date.

stale.description: Source exceeds the configured age threshold; not a credential judgment.

staleAfterDays.description: Configured source-age warning threshold in days.

provenance.description: Snapshot provenance, or null for static reference topics.

returnedCount.description: Complete people or reference entries returned on this page. Fewer than limit means the results ended or the response size budget ended the page; while hasMore is true, the notice names the offset to continue from.

topic.description: One FAA vocabulary, interpretation guide, or mirror diagnostic topic.

totalCount.description: Total matches after filtering, before paging.
